data.name: Maryam
data.gender_notes: Maryam is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Arabic form of the Hebrew Miriam. Standard interpretations give 'beloved' or 'exalted'; some derive it from a root meaning 'bitter'. Its root is م-ر-ي-م. The mother of Jesus (ʿĪsā); a chapter of the Qur'an (Sūrat Maryam) is named after her. Maryam is a Arabic name meaning “Beloved; exalted; (also) bitter”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Maryam expresses “Beloved; exalted; (also) bitter”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: The Arabic form of the Hebrew Miriam. Standard interpretations give 'beloved' or 'exalted'; some derive it from a root meaning 'bitter'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maryam total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
